title: Oriental Mindoro power grid placed on red alert

blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Oriental Mindoro power grid was placed under red alert by the National Transmission Corporation Small Island Grid System Operator (TransCo‑SIGSO) on Wednesday (October 28) from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m. and again from 6 p.m. to 10 p.m., as available capacity fell short of demand amid multiple energy challenges facing the province. According to an advisory from the Oriental Mindoro Electric Cooperative (Ormeco), only 72.39 Megawatts of the grid’s 95.30 MW contracted capacity was dependable for the day, with a projected shortfall of 5.05 MW at the 2 p.m. peak.
